title: Capacity Regulator panel: single-pane scaling controls, throughput insights, and audit lane
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a unified 'Capacity Regulator' panel inside the Console where operators can tune per-fleet scaling knobs, inspect real-time and historical throughput KPIs, and review an immutable change history with approvals. This work covers the UI surface, API contract adjustments, and telemetry additions required to enforce throughput guarantees and make autoscale behavior visible and reversible.
acceptance_criteria: Panel reachable from Fleet detail page and via global Capacity menu
Scaling controls: adjustable target qps, min/max node counts, burst window, and priority weights; persisted via API and surfaced in fleet manifest
Throughput dashboard: 1m/5m/1h throughput, p95/p99 latency, active connections, and token/sec charts; supports time range and compare-to-baseline
Change history: immutable log entries for UI/API changes, actor, timestamp, reason (optional), and linked rollout IDs; ability to filter by user and change type
Audit/Governance: SSO identity preserved on changes and entries exportable as CSV
Autoscale simulation: local scenario runner that previews estimated node counts and cost for a 24h workload trace
End-to-end tests: e2e that exercises scaling settings sync with Dedicated control plane and observes resulting metrics in dashboard
